## 0. Card

- **WS-06, dense geometry + coverage + scene builder.** Goal: from refined poses (WS-04) and the scale block (WS-05), produce a metric dense cloud, a fog-of-war coverage grid with bands under the §3.1 rule, a chain completed from ARKit plane anchors and capture taps where photos saw walls edge-on, coverage-driven `views_needed` for the meter chain, and a validated `base-scene/v0` `scene.json` anchored at the meter, for the criteria engine (WS-09), result composer (WS-10) and scorers (WS-11). Three orchestrator stages: `dense` (GPU), `coverage` (CPU), `scene` (CPU); `dense ← poses, scale`, `coverage ← dense`, `scene ← coverage, objects (terminal)`; `objects_3d` (WS-07) runs after `scene`, then the coordinator calls `merge_objects` (SD-08).
- Builder model: Grok 4.7. Validator: a separate agent (any model), never the builder.
- Inputs: `NormalizedPacket` + packet directory (WS-02, `packet/normalized.json`); `poses/cameras.json`, `poses/sparse.ply`, `poses/tracks.npz`, `poses/registration_report.json` (WS-04, SD-03); `scale/scale.json` (WS-05, SD-04); optional `objects/objects.json` (WS-07, 2D detections, SD-06) at `scene`; `objects/objects_3d.json` (WS-07, scene-frame `Object`s) at `merge_objects`.
- Outputs (SD-05 names, per stage folder under `runs/{runId}/`): `dense/` → `dense.ply`, `flagged.ply`, `depth/<keyframeId>.npz`, `dense_report.json`; `coverage/` → `coverage.npz`, `bands.json`, `points.ply`, `scene_draft.json`, `coverage_report.json` (carries the coverage-driven `views_needed`, §4 step 17); `scene/` → `scene.json`, `build_report.json`, `coverage_topdown.png`, plus copies of every asset it references (`scale.json`, `coverage.npz`, `points.ply`, `dense.ply`, `sparse.ply`). `preview.ply` is WS-10's (`result/preview.ply`, SD-07), built from `points.ply`.
- Repo `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`, branch `ws-06/dense-scene`, one PR.

## 3. Interfaces

Units metres, seconds, pixels; poses ARKit camera-to-world `mat4` column-major; scene frame `meter_anchored/v0` (contract §1). Three frames: `source` (WS-04 `source_frame`: `arkit_world:<epoch>` or `colmap_model`), `W` (metric, +y up: source scaled by WS-05 and, for `colmap_model`, rotated to gravity), `scene` (`T = canonical_from_world(meter_foot, up, outward)`); `frame.from_source = T @ T_W_from_source`.

Read (fail with `SceneError("input_missing:<name>")` if absent):
- WS-04 `poses/cameras.json` (list of `{image, keyframe_id, epoch, pose, intrinsics, w, h, pose_source, reproj_px, points3D}`), `poses/sparse.ply` (`x y z red green blue n_views`), `poses/tracks.npz` (`indptr, indices, point_ids`), `poses/registration_report.json` (`mode, status, source_frame, fragments[], meter, closeups, lidar_frames`).
- WS-05 `scale/scale.json` (`ScaleBlock` + WS-05's additive fields): this WS reads `source` (`meter_model|lidar|arkit|none`), `status`, `rel_bound_95`, `scale_factor` (source → metres; `null` when `source: none`, treated as 1.0), `origin_m` ([3] in source-frame units, or null → mean camera centre; SD-04 name). Stub when the file is missing [default chosen; matches what WS-05 emits with no metric source]: guided `{"source": "arkit", "status": "unverified", "rel_bound_95": 0.09, "scale_factor": 1.0, "origin_m": null}` (WS-05's ARKit-only modern posterior ≈ 0.09), photo flow `{"source": "none", "status": "unverified", "rel_bound_95": 1.0, "scale_factor": 1.0, "origin_m": null}`, plus warning `scale_missing`.
- WS-07 `objects/objects.json` (SD-06, optional, read at `scene`): `{"format": "hss-objects/v0", "objects": [{"id", "class", "label"?, "confidence", "views": [{"image": <keyframe id>, "box_px": [u0,v0,u1,v1], "score"}], "attrs"?: {}}], "ground_type"?: [{"image": <frame id>, "material": <scene Region.material>, "confidence": 0–1}]}`; `ground_type` (SD-47) is a list of per-frame votes already in the scene enum (`lawn|gravel|concrete|pavers|mulch|dirt|deck|drive|walkway|unknown`, WS-07 maps its B1 classes before writing); WS-06 takes the mode over the votes of the frames that saw a region and requires ≥ 2 agreeing votes, else `unknown`; an absent field is `unknown`. `objects/objects_3d.json` (SD-06, read by `merge_objects` only): `{"format": "hss-objects-3d/v0", "objects": list[Object]}`, scene v0 `Object`s already in the scene frame with `source.views[]`.
- Packet: `taps[]` (`label, keyframe, pixel, hit.position`; labels `meter`, `corner`, `wall_end_left`, `wall_end_right`, `window_corner`, `door_corner`), `planes[]` (`id, epoch, alignment, classification, transform, planeExtent, boundary`; ARKit vertical plane anchors for wall completion), `stills[]` (`gravity`, purposes), `keyframes[].depth`, `source.kind`, `packetId`, `session.tier`, WS-02 `ext.hss.derived.{flow,branch}`.

```python
# server/dense/params.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DenseParams:
    window: int = 8; stride: int = 4                 # HSS_DENSE_WINDOW / HSS_DENSE_STRIDE (16 allowed)
    same_facing_cos: float = 0.5                     # PR #12 window rule, forward·forward > 0.5 [default chosen]
    conf_threshold: float = 0.15                     # π³ sigmoid conf (housepipe)
    flying_pixel_rel: float = 0.05                   # A3 5x5 depth-range filter
    window_rms_max_m: float = 0.10                   # Sim(3) residual -> window_pose_inconsistent [default chosen]
    window_scale_dev_max: float = 0.05               # vs median window scale [default chosen]
    second_opinion: str = "auto"                     # da3|none|auto (auto = da3 in the photo flow only) [default chosen]
    disagree_max_m: float = 0.15                     # π³ vs DA3 median NN distance within 6 m [default chosen]
    lidar_method: str = "tsdf"                       # tsdf|points; HSS_DENSE_LIDAR_METHOD
    geometry: str = "auto"                           # auto|lidar|image; HSS_DENSE_GEOMETRY (was housepipe HSS_GEOMETRY; SD-11)
    lidar_max_m: float = 5.0; lidar_min_m: float = 0.2; lidar_min_conf: int = 1
    tsdf_voxel_m: float = 0.04; tsdf_trunc_vox: float = 4.0; tsdf_min_weight: float = 1.0
    depth_model: str = "moge2-vits"                  # Ruicheng/moge-2-vits-normal (MIT)
    weights_dir: Path = Path("/vol/hf")              # HSS_DENSE_WEIGHTS (was HOUSE_WEIGHTS; SD-11); WS-12 sets it and HSS_DENSE_GEOMETRY=auto in secrets_for("pipeline") (SD-59)
    max_depth_frames: int = 100                      # stride = ceil(n / 100) [default chosen]
    dense_cap: int = 500_000
```

`SceneParams(voxel_m=0.05, relief_m=0.10, relief_rel=0.04, ground_rule=os.environ.get("GROUND_RULE_DEFAULT", "angle80"), detector_pm_extra_m=0.20, fallback_floor_m=0.15, corner_refit_radius_m=3.0, glass_behind_m=(0.2, 1.2), complete_walls=True, plane_min_extent_m=1.0, completion_pm_m=0.30, phantom_min_sparse_pts=30, ground_guard_max_above_base_m=0.30, ground_base_min_pts=60, ground_base_min_views=2, ground_unobserved_pm_m=0.30, views_needed_max=8, seed=7)` in `server/scene/params.py` (env `HSS_SCENE_<UPPER_NAME>` for the scene-stage knobs, `HSS_COVERAGE_*` for grid and requests; `GROUND_RULE_DEFAULT` stays WS-00's bare shared knob, SD-11); `DenseReport`, `CoverageReport`, `DepthMap` (`depth (h/4, w/4) float32, NaN = none`, `scale`, `source: lidar|moge2`) are dataclasses next to their stage.

`python -m server.scene.pipeline --packet DIR/packet.arkit-nonlidar.json --poses OUT/poses --scale OUT/scale.json --out OUT [--objects OUT/objects.json] [--anchor-from-tap reference_point] [--meter-frames k00012:1010,655,k00013:990,640] [--cpu] [--max-frames N]` runs the three stages in order into `OUT/{dense,coverage,scene}/`. The two anchor flags are test-only (`meter.source: override`), because no fixture packet carries a `meter` tap.

Errors (`SceneError(code)`, raised from `run(ctx)`; WS-03 records `StageRecord.error_code`): `input_missing:<name>`, `no_meter_anchor` (no tap, detection, registered close-up or override), `meter_not_on_wall` (extractor `RuntimeError("meter clicks hit no wall")`), `no_wall` (no line with ≥ 60 points in the 0.1–2.5 m band and no completed wall), `gravity_unknown` (photo flow, no stills gravity and ground fit tilt > 12° from the initial guess), `timeout`. Warnings (in the stage report and `provenance.notes`): `scale_missing`, `window_pose_inconsistent:<k>`, `pi3_da3_disagree:<k>`, `depth_scale_unavailable:<frame>`, `grid_voxel_raised`, `fallback_poses_widened`, `image_only_unchecked`, `sfm_bent_suspected`, `wall_completed:<wall id>:<plane id|tap id>`, `wall_dropped_no_sparse_support:<k>`, `incidence_clamped`, `ground_plane_rejected:<height_m>` and `ground_base_unobserved` (step 10 g, A7).

## 4. Behaviour spec

Stage `dense` (GPU): steps 1–8. Stage `coverage` (CPU): steps 9–18 (anchor, extractor, wall completion, grid, bands and the coverage-driven requests live here because bands and requests need the chain). Stage `scene` (CPU): steps 19–22.

1. **Frame W.** `factor, origin = scale.scale_factor, scale.origin_m or mean camera centre`; scale points and camera centres about `origin` (housepipe `lidar._scale_about`, now `server.scale.lidar`). Guided modes: up = +y (`gravity_source: arkit`). `colmap_model`: up = median over stills that carry `gravity` of `R_c2w @ DEVICE_FROM_CAMERA.T @ (-g)` (`packetgen/conventions.py` matrix; `gravity_source: imu`), else the normal of the plane fitted to the camera centres, sign chosen so most points lie below (`gravity_source: ground_plane_fit`), refined by the extractor's `ransac_plane_up(max_tilt_deg=12)`. Rotate W so up = +y; record `T_W_from_source`. If the extractor's ground normal ends more than 10° from the gravity up, warn `sfm_bent_suspected` and apply the fallback floors (folded image-only models are the photo flow's main failure: −45.7 % / −18.8 % scale on 2 of 5 real segments, A6).
2. **Registered set.** Frames from `cameras.json` only (primary fragment). Non-primary fragments and unregistered frames contribute nothing; their regions stay unknown by construction.
3. **Windows (both branches).** Order frames by (`epoch`, `timestamp`); windows of `window` frames every `stride`; drop members whose forward axis (`-R[:,2]` of the c2w pose) has cosine ≤ 0.5 with the window's first frame; skip windows with < 3 members. Resize each image to `net_wh(w, h, 518)` (aspect-matched multiples of 14; 1920×1440 → 518×392; never cover-crop, A2's 518×336 crop cost the facade its near ground).
4. **π³ per window.** `pi3_window` (bf16 autocast). Depth per view = `local_points[..., 2]`; flying-pixel filter (drop a pixel whose 5×5 depth range > 5 % of its depth); mask `sigmoid(conf) > 0.15`. Align the window's predicted cameras to the refined SfM centres with `server.common.geometry.umeyama(pred_centers, sfm_centers, with_scale=True)`; record `scale`, residual `rms_m`. Flag `window_pose_inconsistent` when `rms_m > 0.10` or `|scale / median_scale − 1| > 0.05`. Points from flagged windows go to `flagged.ply` and nowhere else (no wall fits, no coverage rays). Evidence: per-window Sim(3) scale swings −2.7 % to +3.9 % on real phone frames (A6); single windows go bad with p90 ≥ 23 in (A2 handoff §7).
5. **Second opinion (DA3-Large).** When `second_opinion` resolves to `da3` (photo flow, where no ARKit trajectory checks the windows): `da3_window` fed the refined poses (`process_res=504`, `upper_bound_resize`; never images-only: one DA3 images-only window failed at +45 % scale, A6). Run π³ for all windows, free it, then load DA3 (both do not fit beside each other on 24 GB; `models` comes from WS-03's `Pipeline`, ask it for `da3` lazily as housepipe `_ensure_da3`). Per window: median nearest-neighbour distance from π³ points to DA3 points within 6 m of the window cameras; `> 0.15 m` → flag `pi3_da3_disagree`, treated as step 4 flags. DA3 points never enter the cloud.
6. **LiDAR branch** (`derived.branch == "lidar"`, i.e. `arkit_lidar` with depth files present; `HSS_DENSE_GEOMETRY=auto|lidar|image` overrides as housepipe `geometry`). Read depth + confidence with `server.scale.lidar.read_depth` (size check `w·h·4` / `w·h`), keep `conf ≥ 1`, `0.2 < z ≤ 5.0`. `tsdf`: Open3D `o3d.t.geometry.VoxelBlockGrid(voxel_size=0.04, block_resolution=8, block_count=60000)`, `trunc_voxel_multiplier=4`, `depth_trunc=5.0`, `extract_triangle_mesh(weight_threshold=1.0)` (the default 3 yields near-empty meshes; the legacy `ScalableTSDFVolume` returns empty meshes in Open3D 0.20; `block_resolution 16` with 200 000 blocks was OOM-killed at 16 GB, A3 handoff §4–5), depth intrinsics scaled from `K_full` by `dw/w, dh/h` (256×192 on a 1920×1440 image) as `lidar._unproject`; mesh vertices become points. `points`: `server.scale.lidar.fuse(cameras, depths, stride=4, cap=250_000)`. Dense cloud = TSDF points ∪ π³ points farther than 5 m from every camera (`lidar.far_points`). Fuse only on WS-04 poses: simulated LiDAR on true poses 0.7 / 2.7 in, on un-refined ARKit poses 1.9 / 9.8 in (A3).
7. **Image branch.** Dense cloud = π³ points from unflagged windows, subsampled stride 4, deduplicated at 2 cm, capped at `dense_cap` [default chosen; housepipe capped at 250 000]. Dense depth on COLMAP poses is coverage evidence, never a measurement source (A10 §1, §3.1: on the DSLR facade photo flow π³ / DA3 depth at COLMAP poses completed the meter wall to 93–99 % within 10 cm and roughly doubled scored key distances, at 1.0–2.5 in median but 7–21 in p90, outside the 2–6 in bar; the sparse COLMAP model scored 0.3–0.6 / 2.5–4.5 in): dense points feed the grid rays, the occlusion test and wall-band completion, while fitted walls, corners and openings must rest on sparse support (step 10 e) and a span supported by dense points only widens `plus_minus_m`, never narrows it `[default chosen]`.
8. **Depth maps (`depth/`).** LiDAR frames: the LiDAR depth (conf ≥ 1). Others: MoGe-2 ViT-S via `server.coverage.occlusion.predict_depth(model, rgb, K)` on every `ceil(n/100)`-th frame; scale each map to the frame's SfM track points (median `z_sfm / z_pred`, ≥ 20 points, else `depth_scale_unavailable`: no depth test for that frame). Store `depth/<keyframe id>.npz` at 1/4 resolution (float32, NaN = none, 3×3 minimum filter applied) with `scale`, `source`. Never use raw MoGe-2 scale (+9 % on electro, A3/A8). Write `dense.ply` (`x y z src`, `src` 1 pi3 / 2 lidar, frame W), `flagged.ply`, `dense_report.json` (per-window scales, flags, counts, timings).
9. **Anchor.** Meter clicks `(cam_index, u, v)` in this order: taps `label == "meter"`; WS-07 `class == "meter"` view boxes (centre) in ≥ 2 registered views; registered `meter_close` / `meter_oblique` frames (centre pixel `(w/2, h/2)`); `--meter-frames` / `--anchor-from-tap` overrides. None → `no_meter_anchor`.
10. **Extractor.** `points_W` = dense ∪ sparse; `tracks` = sparse tracks from `tracks.npz` followed by one pseudo-track per dense point listing the cameras of its window (LiDAR: its frame); `cams` = `Camera(id, pose_W, K, w, h)` per registered frame. `server.eval.extract.extract_scene(points_W, tracks, cams, meter_clicks, features=[], ExtractParams(scale_rel_pm=scale.rel_bound_95, voxel_m=0.05, seed=7), provenance, scene_id, source_frame, T_W_from_source)`. Additive fixes: (a) glass filter: drop a fitted segment within 5° of a chain wall, 0.2–1.2 m behind it, with < 30 % of its points (window-glass virtual depth broke A1's dense runs: p90 34 → 741 in); (b) corner refit from lines fitted to points within 3 m of the corner on both walls when each side has ≥ 60 points (harness TODO: corners 12–17 in off on dense clouds); (c) `support.views` = distinct cameras in the segment's tracks; (d) floors: `pose_source == "arkit"` adds 0.15 m to every wall, corner and object `plus_minus_m` and notes `fallback_poses_widened` (A6 real fixed-pose openings 2.2 / 7.3 in); `sfm_epoch_aligned` frames add their join RMS; (e) phantom guard (E2E §4: the π³-fused facade model grew a phantom wall left of w1): a fitted wall segment whose points are ≥ 90 % π³ and which has fewer than `phantom_min_sparse_pts` (30) sparse COLMAP points within `line_thr_m` (0.08 m) is dropped from `walls[]` and the chain with warning `wall_dropped_no_sparse_support:<k>` (TSDF/LiDAR segments are exempt) `[default chosen]`; (f) every `s_m` span written is sorted `start ≤ end` (the E2E facade door on w3 came out reversed and crashed the PR #11 adapter; the WS-11 harness fix is separate); (g) ground-fit guard (A7 §1, §5.1: at the iPhone's 53° vertical FoV the wall base is thin, and the reference extractor's RANSAC ground snapped to the tops of 0.45–0.75 m street furniture 1–4 m in front of the wall on all six surviving facade runs, putting every height KD 20–36 in off with a confident ±0.08 m bound): the ground is the lowest well-supported horizontal plane; a candidate plane whose height exceeds the lowest wall-base points (points within 0.3 m of a chain wall's baseline, lowest 5 %) by more than `ground_guard_max_above_base_m` (0.30 m) is rejected with warning `ground_plane_rejected:<height_m>` `[default chosen]`; when the wall-base band (0–0.3 m above the fitted ground along the meter wall) holds fewer than `ground_base_min_pts` (60) points or `ground_base_min_views` (2) views, `ground.plus_minus_m` is widened to ≥ `ground_unobserved_pm_m` (0.30 m), every height-referenced `plus_minus_m` inherits it, warning `ground_base_unobserved` is written and step 17 emits the framing request; a datum that the guard cannot verify is `unsure`, never a confident wrong answer. Other `ExtractParams` at defaults (`join_m 1.5`, `line_thr_m 0.08`, `min_wall_pts 60`, `gap_m 3.0`, `fit_radius_m 14`, `fit_voxel_m 0.05`, `merge_angle_deg 5`, `merge_offset_m 0.15`, `merge_gap_m 4`, `wall_min_high_share 0.15`).
11. **Wall completion (guided flow; E2E: facade w2 and w3 are seen edge-on at 78° and are never reconstructed from photos).** Candidates, in order: (a) packet `planes[]` with `alignment: vertical`, `classification: wall`, `planeExtent.width ≥ plane_min_extent_m` (1.0 m) and `height ≥ 1.0 m`, from the anchor epoch or a joined epoch, transformed by `T_W_from_source` and projected to a plan baseline; when no plane is classified `wall`, unclassified vertical planes of the same extent `[default chosen]`; (b) taps `corner`, `wall_end_left`, `wall_end_right` (`hit.position`, same transform). A candidate whose baseline lies within `merge_offset_m` (0.15 m) and `merge_angle_deg` (5°) of a fitted chain wall extends that wall's `s_range_m` to the plane's extent (the wall keeps its evidence; `observed_fraction` comes from the grid, step 14). Otherwise it becomes a new wall `wp<k>` (`role: house`, `evidence: inferred`, `plus_minus_m = completion_pm_m` (0.30 m), `support.points` = points within 0.15 m, `support.views: []`) and joins `chain.wall_ids` only when its end lies within `join_m` (1.5 m) of a chain end, with a corner `evidence: inferred`, `plus_minus_m 0.30`; a `corner` tap within 1.0 m of such a corner sets `point_m` to the tap hit. A `wall_end_*` tap within 1.0 m of a chain end sets `ends.<side>.point_m` and `note: "tap wall_end_<side>"`; `kind` stays `unexplored` unless step 15's free-space rule fires. Completed walls receive bands only from the grid, so an unseen completed wall has no `wall` band and every query on it returns `unobserved`: completion adds the chain, never coverage. Warning `wall_completed:<id>:<source id>` per wall; `complete_walls=False` disables the step. Fixture note: the golden packets carry no `planes[]` (packetgen writes none) and only a `reference_point` tap, so completion is unit-tested on the synthetic box house and first exercised for real on WS-13's captures.
12. **Coverage grid.** Extent: x from min baseline x − 4 to max + 4, y −0.5..6.0, z from min(−2, min z − 2) to max z + 16 (as `eth3d/gt_common.finish_gt`); voxel 0.05 m; above 60 M voxels raise to 0.075 m and warn `grid_voxel_raised`. Ray sets (`HSS_COVERAGE_RAY_SOURCES`, default `tracks,lidar,dense`): (a) camera centre → each track point (`end_is_surface=None`); (b) LiDAR returns conf ≥ 1, 0.2–5 m, pixel stride 2 (`True`); (c) π³ pixels of unflagged windows, conf > 0.15, within 6 m of the camera, stride 8 (`True`). `server.eval.coverage.build_grid(ray_sets, lo, hi, voxel)`. Space a model filled in never counts; DA3 and flagged windows contribute no rays.
13. **Depth-aware query.** `DepthAwareCoverageQuery(CoverageQuery)` in `server/coverage/query.py`: blockers = scene points; a probe additionally counts as unseen by frame i when `depth_i(u,v) + max(0.10, 0.04·z) < z`, or when frame i has a depth map but none at `(u,v)` (PR #12 / A3 rule; 0.0 ft false-observed at 0.10 m relief, 0.6–1.1 ft at 0.4 m). Frames without a depth map fall back to the blockers-only test (`VisibilityOracle.seen_by`, `rel_tol 0.03`, `abs_tol 0.05`).
14. **Bands and rule.** `coverage.method = "rays: sfm_tracks[+lidar_returns][+pi3_depth]; occlusion: blockers + <lidar|moge2> depth, relief max(0.10 m, 4 %)"`, `coverage.grid = grid.meta("coverage")`, `coverage.rule = coverage_rule()` (walls 75°, ground 80°, min views 2), `coverage.bands = bands_from_grid(grid, scene, query=q)`, `coverage.sensitivity = ground_sensitivity(grid, scene, q)` (angle75, angle80, footprint3in), `set_wall_observed_fraction(scene, q)`. Every `best_incidence_deg` / `worst_best_incidence_deg` written is clamped to `[0, 90]` with warning `incidence_clamped` (E2E: a 90.2° rounding failed the schema maximum and dropped 6 C2 verdicts; the harness-side fix is WS-11's). Also write `bands.json` (`{"bands": …, "sensitivity": …, "rule": …}`) for WS-03's artifact list and the early hint code.
15. **Evidence upgrades.** Corner `inferred → observed` when both adjoining faces are well observed within 0.3 m of the corner at heights 0.15, 0.5, 1.0 m; chain end `unexplored → limit` when the grid marks free space observed (≥ 2 views) 0.5–1.5 m past the end at heights 0.5–1.5 m and no wall-band points exist there, `note: "free space observed past the end"`; else `unexplored` [default chosen].
16. **Overheads and facing.** `profile_entries(points_scene, scene, pm_m=round(0.05 + rel_bound_95 * 5.0, 3), min_count=3)`.
17. **Coverage-driven `views_needed` (E2E: coverage grading, not geometry error, is the main cause of undecided outcomes; unobserved ground strips and unexplored ends dominate on the walkarounds).** For every wall in `chain.wall_ids` (fitted or completed), at the 0.25 m stations of step 14 and heights 0.3–2.0 m, group consecutive stations whose wall band is absent, `unobserved`, `grazing`, has `views < 2` or `best_incidence_deg > 75` into spans ≥ 0.5 m; emit one request per span: `{"id": "vn-cov-<wall>-<k>", "kind": "band", "band": "wall", "wall_id", "s_m": [a, b], "target": "head-on view of wall <id> between s = a m and b m: stand 3–5 m out, camera within 30° of the wall normal, wall filling most of the frame", "criteria": [], "why": "coverage: <status>, best incidence <deg>°", "view_angle_deg": [0, 30]}`. Ground: for each chain wall, spans of the 0–3.7 m strip without a `ground` band → `band: ground`, `out_m: 3.7`, `target: "look down at the ground in front of wall <id> from 2 m and 4 m out, camera about 45° down"`, `view_angle_deg: [20, 60]`; the step 10 (g) `ground_base_unobserved` warning adds one `band: ground` request on the meter wall (`s_m` = the meter ± 2 m, `why: "ground datum: wall base not observed"`, `target: "from 3 m out, hold the phone level so the bottom of the wall and at least 1 m of ground are in frame"`) as the A7 framing rule's server-side trigger. Ends: a chain end with `kind: unexplored` → `kind: past_end`, `side`, `target: "walk past the <side> end of wall <id> and photograph the adjoining wall head-on"`, `view_angle_deg: [0, 30]`. Keep at most `views_needed_max` (8), longest spans first; meter-wall spans before others `[default chosen]`. Write them to `coverage_report.json` under `views_needed` (verdict `ViewNeeded` fields plus `view_angle_deg`; SD-57: until spec PR 2 lands the field exists only here, WS-09 merges the requests into the verdicts with `criteria` filled and omits the field, and WS-10 derives `viewingAngleDeg` as `[0, 30]` for `wall` / `past_end` and `[20, 60]` for `ground`, the same numbers written here). The wall id is always present; the angle band is the request's substance.
18. **Coverage outputs.** `coverage.npz` (`grid.save`), `points.ply` via `server.eval.sceneio.write_ply` (float32; Open3D writes doubles other tools misread, A1) with `n_views (int32)`, `src (uint8: 0 sparse, 1 pi3, 2 lidar)`, `scene_draft.json` (the scene so far: frame, walls, chain, ground plane, meter object, keyframes, coverage, overheads, facing; validates except for assets), `coverage_report.json` (bands summary, warnings, `views_needed`, timings).
19. **Objects.** At `scene`, WS-07's 2D `objects/objects.json` (SD-06) entries are cast onto chain walls via the extractor's `cast` with roles `left=(u0,(v0+v1)/2)`, `right=(u1,(v0+v1)/2)`, `bottom=((u0+u1)/2,v1)`, `top=((u0+u1)/2,v0)` (classes `window|door|garage_door|basement_well|panel|wall_box|vent|disconnect|gas_meter|ac_unit`; a box seen in ≥ 2 registered views is cast from the view with the smallest incidence), `plus_minus_m` += 0.20 (B1: box edges include sills and lintels, 35 cm vertical error) [default chosen]; `source.kind: detector`, `source.model`, `source.views[]`, `confidence` from WS-07; `attrs` copied verbatim (missing = unknown). Taps `window_corner`/`door_corner` only when four corners of one object group within 1.5 m after casting [default chosen]. `merge_objects(scene_path, objects_3d_path)` (called by the coordinator after `objects_3d`, SD-08): WS-07's scene-frame `Object`s are copied verbatim (they already carry `plus_minus_m`, `source.views[]`, `evidence`); a 3D object of the same class whose `wall_rect`/box overlaps a cast 2D object within 0.3 m replaces it [default chosen]; the result is re-validated. Idempotent: a repeat call replaces objects with `source.kind ∈ {detector, vlm}` and keeps taps and the meter anchor.
20. **Ground regions.** One region per ground band: rectangle `s0..s1 × 0..out_m` in plan, `material` = the mode of WS-07's `objects.json.ground_type` votes (SD-47) from the frames that saw the region, accepted only with ≥ 2 agreeing votes (`source.kind: vlm`, `confidence` = agreeing share), else `unknown`; `unknown` without WS-07 or without the field (`source.kind: reconstruction`); `evidence: observed`; `slope_deg` = angle between the fitted ground normal and +y. No band → no region (contract §2.4: never assumed allowed; `unknown` is never allowed ground).
21. **Assets, scale block, provenance.** `assets`: `points` (`point_cloud`, `points.ply`, `in_scene_frame: true`, `count`, `fields`, `sha256`), `coverage` (`coverage_grid`, `coverage.npz`, `sha256`). The WS-05 block is mirrored verbatim at `provenance.producer.params.scale` and copied to `scene/scale.json`; there is no top-level `scene.scale` key (D-04 final / SD-04: validation rejects unknown keys). `keyframes[]` = every registered camera in the scene frame with `pose_source`: `sfm` when `scale.source ∈ {lidar, meter_model}`, `sfm_scaled_by_arkit` when `arkit`, `arkit` for fallback poses. `provenance`: `data = real` for `source.kind ∈ {device, replay}`, `hybrid` for `synthetic`; `site` = house id or capture id; `producer.path = "hss-geometry"`, `version` = git sha, `params` = resolved `DenseParams`/`SceneParams` + `scale`; `inputs` (`packet_id`, `packet_sha256`, `images_given`, `images_used`, `sensors_used`, adding `arkit_planes` and `taps` when step 11 used them); `scale_source` mapped `lidar→lidar`, `arkit→arkit_poses`, `none→none`, `meter_model→scale_reference` with `scale_reference_ids: []` (the enum has no `meter_model` until the coordinator's spec PR; switch to it when merged); `gravity_source` per step 1; `runtime_s`, `hardware`, `cost_usd = 0.0`, `license = "COLMAP BSD-3; Pi3 BSD-2; MoGe-2 MIT; DA3-Large Apache-2.0; Open3D MIT"`, `notes` = warnings. No `generated_regions`, no `generated_field`: nothing here generates geometry; completed walls are `inferred`, never `generated`.
22. **Write, validate, copies, heartbeat.** `server.eval.sceneio.save_json(scene, out/scene.json)` (runs `validate`); `build_report.json`; `coverage_topdown.png` (plan view of `state` at y = 1.0 m with chain walls, completed walls dashed, and cameras, `server.scene.render`); copies of `scale.json`, `coverage.npz`, `points.ply`, `dense.ply`, `sparse.ply` next to `scene.json` (SD-05: every asset the scene references). Each `run(ctx)` writes under `ctx.work_dir/<stage>/` and uploads that folder to `captures/{captureId}/runs/{runId}/<stage>/` on success (SD-01). `heartbeat()` every 60 s (`dense:<k>`, `depth:<i>`, `grid`, `bands`, `extract`, `complete`, `requests`, `objects`); timeouts `min(deadline_at, start + HSS_<STAGE>_TIMEOUT_S)` with defaults dense 280, coverage 110, scene 110 s [default chosen, under WS-03's 300 / 120 / 120]. Seeds: extractor 7, subsampling `default_rng(0)`; rerun tolerance: wall `s_range_m` ± 0.02 m, band count identical, KD p90 ± 0.3 in.

Meter anchors for fixtures: `scripts/gt_meter_frames.py --gt GT/scene.json --poses OUT/poses` projects the GT meter into the three nearest frontal registered views (`scene_from_recon.pick_meter_views`) and prints `--meter-frames`; barn and yt houses use `--anchor-from-tap reference_point`; `mini-arkit` needs neither. No golden packet carries `planes[]` or `corner` / `wall_end_*` taps (packetgen writes none), so wall completion (§4 step 11) is unit-tested on the synthetic box house (two synthetic vertical `wall` planes, one `wall_end_left` tap) and first exercised for real on WS-13's captures. Weights (`/vol/hf` or `HSS_DENSE_WEIGHTS`, fetched by `python -m server.dense.models --fetch`): π³ + DA3-Large together about 3–5 GB (A2/A6 handoffs), MoGe-2 ViT-S about 0.1 GB. CPU runtimes (4 vCPU): π³ 12–34 s per 8-view window, MoGe-2 ViT-S 2–3 s per image, coverage 15–60 s, extraction 10–30 s; run one heavy process at a time or timings are meaningless (A3). L4: 1–2 s per window, 0.1 s per depth frame.

## 8. Done when

Paste the gate table into the PR. "L4" runs use the full frame set.

1. Unit tests green: synthetic box house (10 cameras, two walls at 90°, known ground) → wall lengths within 0.02 m, corner within 0.03 m, `observed_fraction` ≥ 0.9 on faces the cameras looked at and exactly 0 on the back faces; an occluder box between camera and wall leaves the shadowed wall patch `unknown` with and without the depth test; flagged-window logic (perturbed window rejected, clean accepted); `_scale_about` invariance of camera-to-point distances; gravity-from-stills matrix; ground-material vote rule (two agreeing `ground_type` votes → the material, one vote or a tie → `unknown`, SD-47); **ground-fit guard** (a 0.6 m-tall synthetic box 2 m in front of the wall with the wall base thinned to 5 points never becomes the ground plane; with the base removed the datum is `unsure`: `ground.plus_minus_m ≥ 0.30`, `ground_base_unobserved` warned, one `band: ground` framing request emitted); evidence upgrade rules; **wall completion**: a third wall no camera saw, carried by a synthetic vertical `wall` plane, appears with `evidence: inferred`, `plus_minus_m 0.30`, no `wall` band, `observed_fraction == 0`, `query-coverage` on it `unobserved`, and a `views_needed` entry `band: wall` with `view_angle_deg [0, 30]` names it; a `wall_end_left` tap sets `ends.left.point_m` without changing `kind`; **phantom guard**: a π³-only segment with < 30 sparse points is dropped with `wall_dropped_no_sparse_support`, the same segment with 30 sparse points is kept; spans always sorted; incidence clamp at 90.2° → 90; `merge_objects` idempotence with a 3D object replacing its cast 2D twin; `validate` passes on every emitted scene; `server/eval/extract.py` regression: `eth3d/build_gt.py` and `build_gt_c2.py` reproduce byte-identical `scene.json` (sha in the test).
2. `validate` passes on all eight fixture scenes of §6 (L4; `mini-arkit` on CPU), with `keyframes[].pose_source`, `provenance.scale_source`, `gravity_source` and `provenance.producer.params.scale` matching the branch and the stub/real `scale.json`; no top-level `scale` key.
3. `score-geometry` (L4): electro `arkit-lidar` and facade `arkit-nonlidar`: `false_observed_by_rule` = 0 in every region and `false_observed_claims` empty; `completeness` for `wall_face` after ICP within 20 cm (key names as written by `geomscore.json`) ≥ the same run's sparse-only score (WS-04 `sparse.ply` through `score-cloud --metric`) and ≥ 0.60 on electro / ≥ 0.45 on facade [default chosen; A1 sparse 46–48 %, dense 62–65 % within 10 cm]; `ground_strip` after ICP within 20 cm ≥ 0.10 on the facade image branch [default chosen; A1 dense 15–16 %].
4. Corners (facade image branch): every scored `corner.s[*]` has |error| < 6 in; a corner reported `missing` is acceptable (honest), a corner with |error| ≥ 6 in fails; at least one corner must be `scored` when the dense layer is on, else report why (w2 is seen edge-on at 78°, §12).
5. Facade image branch: the w2 wall band is absent or `grazing` (never `observed`), the courtyard ground has no `ground` band under `angle75`/`angle80` and may under `footprint3in`; `query-coverage` on `w2` returns `status != observed`; `coverage_report.json.views_needed` contains a `band: wall` request on w2 (or a `past_end` request at the chain end nearest w2 when w2 is not in the chain) with `view_angle_deg [0, 30]`, and a `band: ground` request for the courtyard strip. Barn and both yt houses: at least one `past_end` or `ground` request each (E2E §5), never more than 8 in total.
6. Runtime (L4 for `dense`, CPU for the rest; from the stage reports): `dense` ≤ 90 s for `yt-LCPBf86oloE` (153 frames) with `second_opinion` resolving to `none` and ≤ 150 s for facade `pose-free` with DA3; `coverage` ≤ 60 s; `scene` ≤ 30 s [default chosen split of WS-03's 300 / 120 / 120 s timeouts and the plan's 2 min].
7. `points.ply` float32; every `assets[].sha256` matches its file; `dense.ply` and `flagged.ply` load in any PLY reader.
8. Regression gates stay green: WS-00 `make ci`; WS-11 gate table when it lands (0 unsafe passes is WS-09/WS-11's; a scene that claims observed on unseen space would break it, item 3 is the guard).

Report to `internal/build/validation/ws-06.md` (frontmatter per template instructions; sections: commands, gate table, hand checks, verdict per §8 item).

1. Fresh clone, `make fixtures ONLY=all && make gt`, run §7 end to end yourself on electro `arkit-lidar`, facade `arkit-nonlidar`, facade `pose-free` (CPU with `--max-frames 24` is acceptable for the ETH3D runs if you also re-run `scripts/score_scene.py` on the builder's uploaded `scene/` directories under `/vol/results/ws06/` and reproduce the L4 numbers).
2. Open the three `coverage_topdown.png`: observed voxels only along the camera path's view directions; the facade courtyard ground not marked observed; electro's near walls marked. Open `scene.json`: wall bands only on walls with `observed_fraction > 0.5`; `chain.corners[].evidence` and `chain.ends` consistent with the picture; `provenance.producer.params.scale` equal to `scale.json` and no top-level `scale`; any `wp<k>` wall has `evidence: inferred` and no `observed` band. Open `coverage_report.json.views_needed` for facade and one yt house: every entry names a `wall_id` or `side`, carries `view_angle_deg`, and points at a span the top-down picture shows as unobserved or grazing.
3. `python -m server.eval.cli validate` on every scene; `audit-verdict` is WS-09's, skip.
4. `false_observed_by_rule == 0` in every `geomscore.json`; completeness within 0.02 of the builder's table.
5. Sample three `objects[]` with `source.kind == detector` (if WS-07 outputs were used) and confirm `source.views[].box_px` point at real pixels of the listed images.
6. Grep the diff for `generated`, `_truth`, `hallucin`: `generated_regions` absent or empty; `_truth` only in `scripts/` and tests.
7. Kill a run during `dense:` by PID (never `pkill -f`) and rerun: same outputs within §4.22 tolerance; no partial `scene.json`.
8. Fail on any missed §8 threshold, any `observed` claim on facade w2 or courtyard ground, any completed wall with a band the grid did not produce, or numbers that do not reproduce.

## 10. Constraints

- Vision models are GPT-5.5 and Grok 4.7 only; this WS makes no vision-model calls (ground type and object boxes come from WS-07). No Anthropic.
- Never commit real meter numbers, Base SSR prompt text, API keys, or files over 5 MB (`make hygiene` enforces it; weights, fixtures, PLYs, laser GT live under `.fixtures/`, `$HSS_DENSE_WEIGHTS` or `/vol`).
- No customer tools in any assumption (no tape, no markers); scale comes from WS-05 only.
- Licences as §5; no AGPL and no non-commercial weights in the image.
- Cost: at most $40 of the shared $200 Modal cap for this WS; stop and report at $30; iterate on CPU with `--max-frames`.
- Privacy: fixture imagery only (ETH3D evaluation-only, YouTube internal-only); customer photos never enter tests or the repo; depth maps and clouds are derived personal data and stay in the capture's bucket prefix.

## 11. Out of scope and handoffs

- Poses, fragments, close-up registration: WS-04. Scale factor, bound, status, member actions, `server/scale/lidar.py`: WS-05.
- Object detection, VLM confirmation, ground type, the `objects_3d` stage (`objects/objects_3d.json`, after `scene`, SD-08): WS-07; this WS casts 2D boxes at `scene` and merges the 3D objects in `merge_objects`.
- Criteria, `query_region` per measurement, C2 grid (may reuse `coverage.npz`): WS-09, which also merges `coverage_report.json.views_needed` into the verdicts (ids kept, `criteria` filled) and adds its own criterion-driven requests.
- AR anchors via inverse `frame.from_source`, `result/preview.ply`, `previewUrl`, rendering `view_angle_deg` as `viewingAngleDeg` with WS-14's prompt catalogue: WS-10/WS-14 (SD-27).
- Scorer fixes (incidence max-90 rounding, sorted spans, the A7/A10 `taps.py` perfect-click patch, the reference extractor's own ground snap and dense-cloud wall split), extractor v2 rescoring of A1 rows, LaMAR gate: WS-11 (the guard in step 10 g protects this WS's scenes; the harness extractor is WS-11's). Stage timeouts, retries, GPU escalation, `Pipeline` weights: WS-03/WS-12; env plumbing `HSS_DENSE_WEIGHTS=/vol/hf`, `HSS_DENSE_GEOMETRY=auto` through `secrets_for("pipeline")` (SD-59; `HOUSE_WEIGHTS` and `HSS_GEOMETRY` no longer exist): WS-12. The spec PR adding `view_angle_deg` to verdict v0 and `meter_model` to `provenance.scale_source`: the coordinator (seam decisions §9 item 2). Capture-time framing (wall base + ≥ 1 m of ground in frame, phone level) and the `hint`/prompt copy for it: WS-02/WS-14.

## 12. Open questions and defaults

1. Facade corners are seen edge-on (w2 at 78°): the plan's "corner error < 6 in on facade" may be unreachable even with dense. Default: gate as §8.4; propose electro or the WS-13 real house as the corner fixture; on real captures step 11 completes w2/w3 from ARKit planes so the chain exists even where photos cannot score it.
2. Ground rule (angle75 / angle80 / footprint3in) is Base's call. Default: `GROUND_RULE_DEFAULT=angle80` (D-14) as `coverage.rule`, all three in `sensitivity`.
3. `second_opinion` in the guided flow. Default: `none` (the ARKit-trajectory Sim(3) check covers windows); `da3` in the photo flow.
4. TSDF voxel 0.04 m vs 0.02 m for 256×192 LiDAR. Default 0.04 (A3's tested setting; 2 cm is at the LiDAR pixel footprint at 5 m).
5. Depth model: MoGe-2 ViT-S (MIT) vs Metric3D v2 ViT-S (better fused p90, weights licence unverified). Default MoGe-2.
6. `scale/scale.json` absent. Default stub §3 with `rel_bound_95` 0.09 guided (WS-05's ARKit-only posterior) / 1.0 photo and warning `scale_missing`.
7. A7 (iPhone degradation) landed 23:20 UTC, interim (`internal/breadth/A7-iphone-degradation.md`). Applied: the step 10 (g) ground-fit guard and the step 17 framing request (ground-datum flip on every surviving narrow-FoV facade run, −20 to −36 in with ±0.08 m claims). Default: no denoising; the feed-forward depth models barely degrade (electro surface error 1.0–1.7 in median at 77–95 % completeness under every condition incl. ISO 6400 and 11 px blur; facade 2.3–4.4 in), while π³'s own poses get 2× worse at the iPhone FoV on wide-baseline sets (camera RMS 29 → 51 cm, 70 cm at dusk), so windows always take WS-04's trajectory (step 4) and never π³ poses; π³ own-pose blow-ups (p90 1402 in) are what the window flags must catch: add a `blur_16`-style perturbed unit test.
8. A10 (photo count) landed 23:21 UTC (`internal/breadth/A10-sparse-photo-flow.md`). Applied: step 7's "coverage only, never measurement" rule with its numbers. Default: photo flow at ≈ 40–70 dense photos (WS-04 thins the mapper set to 48, SD-10); `COLMAP poses + π³ depth` raised facade KDs scored from 25 to 38–40 with phantoms and a 7–21 in p90, so phantom KDs stay informational in the gate table and the step 10 (e) guard stays on; the dense hybrids also scored worst on decidability for a harness reason (the reference extractor splits the meter wall on dense clouds, `views_min 0`), which is WS-11's regression item, not a scene defect.
9. E2E criteria-on-reconstruction landed (22:02 UTC). Applied: wall completion (step 11), coverage-driven `views_needed` (step 17), phantom guard, sorted spans, incidence clamp; §8.3 thresholds stand; decidability (share of criterion cells decided; E2E baseline facade 12–13 %, electro 24–25 % on photos vs 38 % / 75 % laser) is WS-09/WS-11's tracked metric, and WS-06 reports the wall-band coverage share per chain wall in `coverage_report.json` so its effect can be followed.
10. WS-07 shapes. Resolved by SD-06 (§3) and SD-47: `objects.json.ground_type` is a list of per-frame votes in the scene material enum; mode with ≥ 2 agreeing votes, else `unknown`; absent → `unknown`.
11. Scale block home. Resolved (D-04 final / SD-04): `provenance.producer.params.scale` mirror + `scene/scale.json` copy, never a top-level key.
12. ARKit planes absent in every golden packet. Default: completion validated on the synthetic box house and on WS-13's captures; `complete_walls=True` in production, and a packet without `planes[]` simply skips the step.
13. `ViewNeeded` has no angle field until the spec PR. Decided (SD-57): `view_angle_deg` is written in `coverage_report.json.views_needed[]` only; WS-09 merges the requests and omits the field (the copied schema forbids extras) until spec PR 2 merges; WS-10 derives `[0, 30]` for `wall` / `past_end` and `[20, 60]` for `ground`, the same numbers written here.
